meta.name: tldr
meta.description: Compress a document, thread, transcript, or pasted text into a scannable TL;DR.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把长文本压成一眼能看完的摘要
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要快速抓住长文档或对话的要点。
copy.tagline_en: Turn long text into a scannable summary
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly grasp the gist of long documents.

howto.what: 当用户提供一段文字、文件或链接时，Claude 会把它浓缩成一份可直接扫读的简报：先用一行说清核心，再列出三到七条关键点，保留重要数字与条件；源里有行动项或疑问时单独列出，绝不添加原文没有的内容。
howto.when: 在用户要求压缩或概括内容时触发，例如给出链接、粘贴文字、上传文件后让 Claude 总结。

say.text: 把这篇文章压缩成一段要点。
say.note: 得到一行核心加若干要点。

say.text: 总结这份会议记录，行动项单独列出。
say.note: 没有行动项时不会硬列。

say.text: 精简我选中的这段对话。

howto.what_en: Claude turns user-supplied content (text, file, link, selection) into a scannable briefing: one-line gist plus three to seven key points, preserving critical numbers and conditions, with action items only when present. Nothing is invented.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to compress or summarize content they provided, such as by pasting text, uploading a file, or giving a link and requesting a TL;DR.

say_en.text: Summarize this article I just pasted into a few bullet points.
say_en.note: Returns the gist plus key points.

say_en.text: Condense these meeting notes; list action items separately.

say_en.note: Needs the thread text or a link.
